F6 (break_even > N_MAX) is an algebraic identity (N_MAX formula equals break-even formula); cannot fire at any data and N_MAX was never frozen pre-experiment per prereg section 8.4
F9 (null arm cost_ratio_vs_bcold >= 1.0) penalizes correct abstention at zero requests; must be restated as an abstention-cost claim, not a ratio threshold
Decision rule condition 5 ('matched end-to-end success') has no referent because B-LITERAL-REPLAY and B-RETRIEVAL-K5 both measure task success 0.0; requires baselines that succeed
Substrate supplies only 126 resource-B identifiers (42/family), below preregistered n >= 50 (F12); substrate must be extended or n-per-family reduced in a revised prereg

Prereg section 5 orders kernel fixes committed before freeze, but scripts/check_scope.py:124-126 and scripts/freeze_experiment.py:79-82 make this unsatisfiable in every lane; control plane needs a build stage or kernel fixes must move to execute stage
Prereg section 8.4 requires N_MAX frozen in spec.json or freeze.json before freeze; it is absent from both
validity_findings: DURABILITY UNMET: The mandate's central requirement is a DURABLE, committed, hash-verified capability. git diff 244dd5bd..HEAD -- src/ tests/ is empty; the corrected kernel exists only in the working tree (598 lines kernel.py, 206 lines test_kernel.py, 633 insertions). No commit mechanism is authorized for this lane. Durability is UNMEASURED and must not be inferred.

SUBSTRATE DESIGN MISMATCH: The frozen substrate (sha256 d3fe358e...) matches the prereg-declared digest but its actual surface does NOT provide the endpoints prereg section 7 declares (/api/v1/schema, /api/v1/items/*, /api/v1/products/*, Bearer token issuance, pagination with Link headers). The real surface is /{collection}/{id}, ?q=, ?limit=, GET / index, three static tokens with TOKEN_EXPIRY=100 on a monotone store. The digest check is not a design audit.

REPRESENTATION LOSS - B-COLD: Prereg section 7 names /api/v1/schema, ?page=N&page_size=K with Link headers, /api/v1/items/*. None exist. B-COLD was mapped onto GET / index for verb discovery plus ?limit= listing for existence confirmation. It is genuinely executed and counted but is not the procedure the prereg described.

REPRESENTATION LOSS - B-RETRIEVAL-K5: No model key or embedding service available; a deterministic hashed character-n-gram bag of intent+state was substituted for semantic embeddings. This weakens the retrieval baseline and is a declared substitution.

REPRESENTATION LOSS - FAMILY DIVERSITY: Prereg section 9.1 asks for three families with distinct endpoint structures. The substrate offers two collections and four item-level verbs; the three families differ only by VERB and intent namespace, not by URL shape (all share /{collection}/{id}).

PROTOCOL AMENDMENT A1 (TOKEN RE-AUTH): TOKEN_EXPIRY=100 with no issuance endpoint forced a stand-in where a 401 clears the request budget and each re-auth is charged as one real HTTP request. Disclosed before outcome inspection. B-COLD pays periodic re-auth and keeps honest dynamic range.

PROTOCOL AMENDMENT A2 (VERB EXECUTION): An early runner draft supplied the task family's verb instead of the resolved mechanism's verb, silently rescuing the null arm to a false 1.0 success. Found and corrected during execution; the reported NC-SHUFFLED-INTENT-FORCED success of 0.3333 is trustworthy only because of this correction.

SINGLE-COLLECTION TRAINING IS THE STRUCTURAL CAUSE OF PINNING: The 50 induction identifiers all live in one collection ('items'), so the collection segment is constant across the entire training set. A segment that never varies carries no evidence that it SHOULD vary, so prefix-preserving induction pins it. The Treatment 0.0000 result is a property of single-collection training, not evidence that prefix preservation is wrong.

DESIGN DEFECT F2: Requires bound path /api/v1/<collection>/<slot> on a substrate with no /api/v1 prefix; also contradicts T1 which pins the collection (/api/v1/items/${id}) while F2 requires it to vary.

DESIGN DEFECT F6: N_MAX = ceil(induction_cost/(mean_bcold - treatment)) and break-even is the smallest n with amortized ratio <= 1.0. These are the same expression; verified numerically at 50 == 50. The clause is an identity and cannot fire. N_MAX was also never frozen.
DESIGN DEFECT F9: Requires the null arm's cost ratio against B-COLD to be >= 1.0. A correctly abstaining arm issues zero requests, so this threshold penalizes correct abstention.

DESIGN DEFECT MATCHED SUCCESS: Decision rule condition 5 requires treatment to beat baselines 'at matched end-to-end success' while prereg section 8.5 expects literal-replay and retrieval baselines to fail (task success 0.0). Two of three baselines have 0.0 success; the comparison has no referent.

SAMPLE SIZE F12: Prereg requires n >= 50 per family for ALL arms. PC-SAME-RESOURCE reaches 50/family. Every resource-B arm reaches 42/family (126 identifiers / 3 families). This is a substrate capacity limit, not a design choice.
ECE SINGLE-BIN: Every task resolves through one mechanism at one confidence value, so expected calibration error is structurally 0.0 and carries no calibration information.

CONFIDENCE CAN REACH 1.0: On a deterministic substrate with 100% support and 100% template consistency, add-one support leaves confidence at exactly 1.0. The value is computed, not hardcoded, but the substrate cannot exercise the low-confidence regime.

INDUCTION SUPPORT / LEAKAGE SEPARATION: Substrate exposes 200 resource-A identifiers. Indices 0-149 are PC-SAME-RESOURCE held-out set (50/family, disjoint index ranges); indices 150-199 are induction training set (50 distinct identifiers, reused across 3 families for 150 observations). Held-out set is index-disjoint from training set; resource-A and resource-B namespaces are disjoint by construction. The 1.0000 resource-B transfer result (identity-slot variant) is not identifier leakage.

claim_ceiling: A corrected, prefix-preserving parameter-induction pipeline (distill_parameterized, _build_action_template calling _strip_common_prefix, intent-namespace resolution, derived confidence) exists in the working tree and reaches EXECUTABLE through distill_parameterized, verified by 10/10 tests. On this substrate: (1) Induction from a single-collection training set pins the collection segment; the prereg-named Treatment binds /items/${id} and achieves 0.0000 end-to-end success on 126 never-observed resource-B identifiers. (2) When the resource collection is induced as a DECLARED identity slot, the SAME pipeline transfers exactly: 1.0000 success, CI [1.0000, 1.0000], on the same 126 identifiers at 1.0159 requests/task. (3) Against an executed B-COLD at 4.0794 requests/task, the identity-slot mechanism reaches amortized ratio ~0.55, break-even at 50 tasks (126 executed). (4) The min_confidence gate is load-bearing for safety: null arm abstains 126/126; gate bypass yields 66.7% wrong-verb actions. NOT established: durability (nothing committed); any transfer claim at the prereg's /api/v1 bound-path pattern (substrate cannot produce); any cost comparison against B-LITERAL-REPLAY or B-RETRIEVAL-K5 at matched end-to-end success (both baselines score 0.0 task success); anything about real Web APIs, browsers, model tokens, latency, or cross-site transfer.
unresolved: Durability is untested and untestable in this lane. The corrected kernel is not committed and no commit is authorized; the mandate's central DURABLE requirement is neither established nor refuted.

Whether prefix-preserving induction can transfer across resources WITHOUT a declared identity slot is answered negatively here on one substrate with single-collection training. Generalization of that negative to real Web APIs is not established.

Why the parent packet (EXP-PRODUCT-36272385776) recorded transfer success 1.0 at kernel sha256 ac1cbdd9... while the same function family at c7b818eb... provably emitted a prefix-free template remains unresolved; this run did not attempt to reconcile the two artifacts.

Whether the six mechanisms the parent packet induced from permuted intent labels would have produced wrong-verb actions is partially answered: a shuffled-intent mechanism applies the wrong verb on 84/126 tasks, but on this substrate rather than theirs.
N_MAX remains unfrozen. Any future comparison of break-even against a pre-registered constant requires the constant to exist before the arms run.
Whether B-RETRIEVAL-K5 would discriminate with a real semantic embedding is untested; the hashed-n-gram stand-in may be too weak to represent the baseline the prereg intended.
Whether a 42-per-family resource-B sample is sufficient, and what the correct power analysis is for the transfer-success metric, is not established.
C-PRODUCT-ECON, C-LLM-INHERIT, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY, C-FRESHNESS, C-DELTA-REPAIR and C-CROSSSITE were not measured here and their dependence on a durable inheritance capability is unchanged.

The control-plane defect (build-before-freeze unsatisfiable in every lane) is a program-level issue verified independently in EXP-GRAPH-36287167610 and EXP-INTEL-36293264917. It blocks ALL future product-lane prereg with build steps until fixed.
The substrate digest check in freeze is not a design audit. A surface contract test in the freeze gate is needed to prevent silent design mismatches.
